cause: The pidfd notification is prompt. The subsequent synchronous Group.conclude systemctl query waits for the shared user manager during reloads, delaying the durable exit record.
fix: Use successful adapter exit, kernel-empty group before the installed activation deadline, no stop, and a readable final zero OOM counter as ordinary-exit evidence. Keep unread manager results absent. Retain manager settlement for ambiguous exits.
limitations: The explicit one-suite-at-a-time rule prevented the requested parallel-suite mix. Transient-scope churn reproduces shared-manager interference but does not claim the exact full gate workload.

The explicit prohibition on mutation-driver execution takes precedence over the later request to run finding 40. All 40 anchors were statically checked; rejection of the full inventory remains for the reviewer.
The full gate was not run.

method.cleanup: Temporary snapshots, homes, logs and traces are removed by TemporaryDirectory; suite fixtures stop their own slices and remove their own shm directories.
method.latency_precision: Per-run row latency is rounded to milliseconds; the unchanged assertion uses original unrounded timestamps.
method.reloads: A joined thread issues synchronous daemon-reload calls around the idle worker release until its exit row completes. The idle wake window precedes these reloads.
method.scope_load: 15 joined foreground workers repeatedly run transient systemd scopes, each containing sleep 0.5. Every subprocess is waited for.
method.snapshot: Uses check_gate_mutations read_inputs, snapshot and fixed_env helpers without invoking a mutation driver. Production bytes in all before cohorts match 7aca8f15. Diagnostics time pidfd notification, manager queries and scope close.
method.suite_execution: Only python3 scripts/selftest.py --suite 63_veldo_0040_containment, one copy at a time.
